_meta.description: Monkr is a free, open-source device mockup generator that runs entirely in your browser: real device frames, App Store screenshot sets and animated previews, with no uploads and no account.
a-tilted-iphone-mockup.983d3d: A tilted iPhone mockup on a soft gradient, made in Monkr
blaine-miller-all-rights.b327c2: © Blaine Miller. All rights reserved.
canvas-presets-for-every.f5122a: Canvas presets for every App Store and Google Play size, with headlines, layouts and backgrounds that carry across a whole set.
drop-in-a-screenshot.47f121: Drop in a screenshot, pick a device and a background, and download a polished mockup. Free, open source, and it never leaves your browser.
in-your-browser-automatically.bd08f1: In your browser, automatically. Export a .monkr file to keep a project safe or move it to another computer.
no-accounts-no-uploads.056326: No accounts, no uploads, no watermarks.
no-everything-runs-in.df8538: No. Everything runs in your browser, and your images never leave your device.
pixel-true-frames-for.ac02dc: Pixel-true frames for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Apple TV and more, each in its colors. Position, scale, rotate and tilt them in 3D.
projects-save-in-your.2c83ec: Projects save in your browser as you work, and export as .monkr files you can open again anywhere.
recent-iphones-ipads-macs.281e4f: Recent iPhones, iPads, Macs and iMacs, Apple Watch, Apple TV, Studio Display, a few Android phones and light and dark browser windows, many with Apple's official bezels.
seven-animation-presets-from.d04b46: Seven animation presets, from a full spin to a gentle float, export as video. Chain them into short clips and score them with Tom.
the-monkr-editor-layout.096978: The Monkr editor: layout templates and scene presets beside an iPhone on a gradient
the-same-renderer-runs.b48780: The same renderer runs from the command line, pixel-identical to the Export button, so fresh captures become framed screenshots without a click.
yes-monkr-is-free.dd22bf: Yes. Monkr is free and open source under the MIT license, with no watermarks and no account.
